title: A framing effect in context
hook: Two stated cases: explore a context-dependent standardized contrast.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a context-dependent standardized contrast affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines D, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a context-dependent standardized contrast in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A standardized effect divides the raw difference by spread. It does not by itself describe practical importance or replication success. This comparison isolates a context-dependent standardized contrast.
